display_long_description:
# Start Your Wizard Journey

**War of Wizards: Apprentice Edition** invites you into a magical VR world where you draw spells to fight in exciting arena battles.

Start with **1v1 duels** and **PVE mode**, easy to pick up and fun to play.

Upgrade to the full version to unlock 2v2 battles, PK mode, Rune War mode, and more starting spells through in-game purchases.

# Rune War — The Ultimate Roguelike Arena
[media]
Every battle is unique. Every choice matters.
Enter the Rune War and gain powerful augments as you fight! Every 2 minutes, choose 1 of 3 random augments to enhance your combat abilities:

113 unique augments across 3 tiers: Silver, Gold, and Prismatic
Build-defining synergies — your spell loadout influences which augments appear
No two matches are the same — adapt your strategy on the fly
High risk, high reward — chase powerful Prismatic augments or build consistent combos

Master the art of adaptation. Will you stack damage buffs, invest in survivability, or gamble on rare synergies? The Rune War rewards clever choices and quick thinking.

# Drawing-Based Spell Casting

With over 80 spells to learn, casting magic is all about drawing the right symbol.

[media]
Key Features

- Rune War — Roguelike augments with 113 buffs across 3 tiers
- 80+ spells cast by drawing gestures
- 1v1, 2v2 PVP and PVE modes
- Fast-paced strategy with quick reflexes
- Balanced design supporting diverse playstyles
